record.tier: GPU bare-metal servers, month to month

free_tier.stated: No free allowance. Single-tenant bare-metal GPU servers rented month to month, from USD 349 a month. Per-GPU hourly equivalents printed on the page: Tesla T4 16 GB USD 0.48, L4 24 GB USD 0.62 (USD 449 a month), L40S 48 GB USD 1.09 (USD 799 a month), H100 NVL 94 GB USD 2.74 (USD 1999 a month). Not listed: A100 80 GB (an A30 24 GB is, at USD 0.82 per hour) and RTX 4090. Eight-GPU servers in the USA are pre-order with a USD 2500 deposit.

per_object_cap.notes: each server is one physical machine with one to four GPUs; eight-GPU servers are pre-order

retention.stated: Month to month: no long contract, one flat monthly invoice per server. The server is built after payment and delivered within five business days.
retention.notes: the shortest rental is one month; no hourly meter

egress.terms: each server includes 30 TB of bandwidth a month on a 1 Gbps uplink; a 1 Gbps unmetered port is a paid upgrade at USD 199 a month

record.interface_detail: the page states full root access on a bare-metal server and names no access method; not probed
record.tooling: order a server from the pricing table; the server is built and handed over with access details. Support is by ticket, live chat and WhatsApp.
record.chaining: billing is a flat month per server, so a short GPU job costs a full month; the per-GPU hourly figures are the vendor's monthly price divided down, for comparison with hourly clouds.

limits.value: 30 TB bandwidth per month and a 1 Gbps uplink on each server

record.limits_note: the wall is the one-month minimum rental and the identity check on larger orders, which the seven kinds do not name; the only numeric quota is 30 TB of bandwidth a month
record.binding_note: no usage quota binds before the price: the constraint is a one-month minimum rental with no hourly meter, and an online identity check on orders above USD 1000

identity_cost.detail: 'we verify the identity of every customer whose order is above $1000'; the online KYC takes 5-10 minutes and is done once after the first payment; smaller orders may be asked too. The page does not say which documents the check takes: unverified: behind a sign-up. Payment is made before the server is built.

record.reliability_note: unverified: no status page or incident history was read for this offer; the page publishes delivery within five business days for one to four GPUs and up to three months for pre-ordered eight-GPU servers
